== frame picker cursor=3,5
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd one
|testuser@<HOST> ~/one $ cd ../two
|testuser@<HOST> ~/two $ cd ../three
|dirs:
|~/two
|~/one
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd

@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/two
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=default bg=default bold=1 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 dirs:
@4 fg=default bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=1 ~/two

== frame after_escape cursor=3,26
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd one
|testuser@<HOST> ~/one $ cd ../two

|testuser@<HOST> ~/three $
